queries:
WITH invoice_totals AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        COUNT(*) AS line_item_count,
        1.0 * SUM(derived_product_cost)
            / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS invoice_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
)
SELECT
    invoice_number,
    invoice_ratio / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) FROM invoice_totals), 0) AS normalized_ratio,
    line_item_count
FROM invoice_totals

WITH invoice_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    i.invoice_number,
    COUNT(li.invoice_number) AS line_item_count,
    1.0 * SUM(CASE
      WHEN li.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL
       AND li.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
      THEN li.derived_product_cost
    END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE
      WHEN li.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL
       AND li.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
      THEN li.derived_total_cost
    END), 0) AS cost_to_total_ratio
  FROM Invoices AS i
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li
    ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  GROUP BY i.invoice_number
)
SELECT
  invoice_number,
  cost_to_total_ratio / NULLIF(
    (SELECT AVG(cost_to_total_ratio) FROM invoice_ratios), 0
  ) AS ratio_to_mean,
  line_item_count
FROM invoice_ratios

WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        i.invoice_number,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN li.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL
                 AND li.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
                THEN 1.0 * li.derived_product_cost / li.derived_total_cost
            END
        ) AS average_ratio,
        COUNT(li.invoice_number) AS line_item_count
    FROM Invoices AS i
    LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li
        ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
    GROUP BY i.invoice_number
)
SELECT
    invoice_number,
    average_ratio / (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) FROM invoice_averages) AS relative_average_ratio,
    line_item_count
FROM invoice_averages

WITH invoice_totals AS (
  SELECT
    i.invoice_number,
    SUM(li.derived_product_cost) AS product_cost,
    SUM(li.derived_total_cost) AS total_cost,
    COUNT(li.invoice_number) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoices AS i
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li
    ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  GROUP BY i.invoice_number
),
all_totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(derived_product_cost) AS product_cost,
    SUM(derived_total_cost) AS total_cost
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
)
SELECT
  invoice_totals.invoice_number,
  (invoice_totals.product_cost / invoice_totals.total_cost)
    / (all_totals.product_cost / all_totals.total_cost) AS cost_ratio,
  invoice_totals.line_item_count
FROM invoice_totals
CROSS JOIN all_totals

SELECT
    i.invoice_number,
    (1.0 * SUM(li.derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(li.derived_product_cost), 0))
        / (
            SELECT AVG(1.0 * derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost)
            FROM Invoice_Line_Items
            WHERE derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
              AND derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL
              AND derived_product_cost <> 0
        ) AS ratio_to_average_line_item_ratio,
    COUNT(li.invoice_number) AS line_item_count
FROM Invoices AS i
LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li
    ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
GROUP BY i.invoice_number

WITH invoice_totals AS (
    SELECT
        i.invoice_number,
        COUNT(li.order_item_id) AS line_item_count,
        1.0 * SUM(li.derived_total_cost)
            / NULLIF(SUM(li.derived_product_cost), 0) AS cost_ratio
    FROM Invoices AS i
    LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li
        ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
    GROUP BY i.invoice_number
),
weighted_average AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(cost_ratio * line_item_count)
            / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cost_ratio IS NOT NULL THEN line_item_count ELSE 0 END), 0)
            AS average_ratio
    FROM invoice_totals
)
SELECT
    invoice_number,
    cost_ratio / NULLIF(average_ratio, 0) AS normalized_ratio,
    line_item_count
FROM invoice_totals
CROSS JOIN weighted_average
